k: Not a hound. The rumor of one — the feeling of being followed home, given teeth.
src: 'Not a hound. The rumor of one — the feeling of being followed home, given teeth.'

k: Every spilled thought pools somewhere. Down here, it pools into this.
src: 'Every spilled thought pools somewhere. Down here, it pools into this.'

k: Memories nobody kept. They whisper names at you, hoping one of them is theirs.
src: 'Memories nobody kept. They whisper names at you, hoping one of them is theirs.'

k: Drawn to light. There is no light down here, so it is drawn to you.
src: 'Drawn to light. There is no light down here, so it is drawn to you.'

k: The Umbral Hound, after it caught up with someone.
src: 'The Umbral Hound, after it caught up with someone.'

k: Every bad dream ever woken from, knotted together. It wants to finish them.
src: 'Every bad dream ever woken from, knotted together. It wants to finish them.'

k: It has been looking up for a long time, waiting for something to fall.
src: 'It has been looking up for a long time, waiting for something to fall.'

k: Gloam that sat still long enough to crystallize, then got up again.
src: 'Gloam that sat still long enough to crystallize, then got up again.'

k: A soldier of a city whose name fell out of every book at once. Still on patrol.
src: 'A soldier of a city whose name fell out of every book at once. Still on patrol.'

k: A town gate that forgot it was a gate and remembered only that it was supposed to keep people out.
src: 'A town gate that forgot it was a gate and remembered only that it was supposed to keep people out.'

k: It still lights the lamps on its street every evening. There is no street.
src: 'It still lights the lamps on its street every evening. There is no street.'

k: It carried the news of the city's fall to no one. It is still looking for someone to tell.
src: 'It carried the news of the city\'s fall to no one. It is still looking for someone to tell.'

k: A saint whose miracle nobody wrote down. The statue lost its face out of sheer politeness.
src: 'A saint whose miracle nobody wrote down. The statue lost its face out of sheer politeness.'

k: It burned the archive. It does not remember why, which is the only funny thing about it.
src: 'It burned the archive. It does not remember why, which is the only funny thing about it.'

k: Sworn to a lord nobody remembers, against an enemy nobody remembers, forever.
src: 'Sworn to a lord nobody remembers, against an enemy nobody remembers, forever.'

k: It spins its webs out of unread pages. You can read a sentence or two in them, if you get close. Don't.
src: 'It spins its webs out of unread pages. You can read a sentence or two in them, if you get close. Don\'t.'

k: The very first winter had wolves in it. Nobody was alive to remember them. They noticed.
src: 'The very first winter had wolves in it. Nobody was alive to remember them. They noticed.'

k: The light off snow on a morning no one saw.
src: 'The light off snow on a morning no one saw.'

k: Slow as a glacier. Exactly as slow. It is very proud of this.
src: 'Slow as a glacier. Exactly as slow. It is very proud of this.'

k: The first thaw. It has been waiting for spring since before there were seasons.
src: 'The first thaw. It has been waiting for spring since before there were seasons.'

k: It froze at its post. It is still at its post. Some promises are just weather.
src: 'It froze at its post. It is still at its post. Some promises are just weather.'

k: Watching the snow fall. Has never once blinked. Would like to.
src: 'Watching the snow fall. Has never once blinked. Would like to.'

k: Its wingbeats are the reason snow drifts. It is not sorry.
src: 'Its wingbeats are the reason snow drifts. It is not sorry.'

k: Frozen mid-reach. It thawed just enough to finish the motion.
src: 'Frozen mid-reach. It thawed just enough to finish the motion.'

k: A shape the world started, and then forgot to finish. It is trying to finish itself out of you.
src: 'A shape the world started, and then forgot to finish. It is trying to finish itself out of you.'

k: Light, before anyone decided what light was for.
src: 'Light, before anyone decided what light was for.'

k: Everything was this, once. It would like everything to be this again. It is patient.
src: 'Everything was this, once. It would like everything to be this again. It is patient.'

k: Four legs, roughly. A head, approximately. The idea of an animal, charging.
src: 'Four legs, roughly. A head, approximately. The idea of an animal, charging.'

k: The first animal the sun ever shone on. Every hound since is a copy of a copy of it.
src: 'The first animal the sun ever shone on. Every hound since is a copy of a copy of it.'

k: Where the light ended and the dark began, someone had to stand guard. This is the line, wearing armor.
src: 'Where the light ended and the dark began, someone had to stand guard. This is the line, wearing armor.'

k: The first thing that ever saw anything. It has not looked away since.
src: 'The first thing that ever saw anything. It has not looked away since.'

k: Before forests, there was one tree. It was very lonely. It has not forgiven anyone for the others.
src: 'Before forests, there was one tree. It was very lonely. It has not forgiven anyone for the others.'

k: Somebody's wish, still looking for them. Swords pass right through it. Spells do not.
src: 'Somebody\'s wish, still looking for them. Swords pass right through it. Spells do not.'

k: It ate a treasure chest, then everything the chest's owner ever lost. It is mostly stomach now.
src: 'It ate a treasure chest, then everything the chest\'s owner ever lost. It is mostly stomach now.'

k: Every soldier nobody remembers ends up here. Together, they make one knight. It has a great many names and can say none of them.
src: 'Every soldier nobody remembers ends up here. Together, they make one knight. It has a great many names and can say none of them.'

k: Queen of the first winter. She ruled a kingdom of snow with no one in it, and she ruled it very well.
src: 'Queen of the first winter. She ruled a kingdom of snow with no one in it, and she ruled it very well.'

k: What everything was before the sun gave it edges. Not evil. Not anything. It would like you to be nothing too, very gently.
src: 'What everything was before the sun gave it edges. Not evil. Not anything. It would like you to be nothing too, very gently.'

k: A piece of the First Dark that broke off to look at you more closely.
src: 'A piece of the First Dark that broke off to look at you more closely.'

k: Lysa Lorne, ten years old, hiding since the night of the festival. Nobody ever found her. She is very, very good at this game.
src: 'Lysa Lorne, ten years old, hiding since the night of the festival. Nobody ever found her. She is very, very good at this game.'

k: A paper lantern from the summer festival, forty years ago. Still lit. Still warm.
src: 'A paper lantern from the summer festival, forty years ago. Still lit. Still warm.'

k: The first monster you ever fought, the way you remember it: bigger.
src: 'The first monster you ever fought, the way you remember it: bigger.'

k: Even the pups came back bigger.
Every sailor who survived the strait told the story again. Each time, the serpent grew a little.
src: 'Every sailor who survived the strait told the story again. Each time, the serpent grew a little.'

k: Red Tam as Red Tam tells it: eight feet tall, undefeated, beloved by all. The Gloam took him at his word.
src: 'Red Tam as Red Tam tells it: eight feet tall, undefeated, beloved by all. The Gloam took him at his word.'
